Fixture Recall Guide (SYNTHETIC: made-up questions for tests)

Section A: Exam Alpha Recalls

MCQ 1 (Alpha 2099 – MCQ 1): Made-up Marker Question
●​    Topic Discussion: The fixture marker Zeta is raised in condition Q in 10–15% of cases.
   ●​ Question Stem: Which fixture marker is raised in condition Q?
   ●​ Options: A. Zeta marker | B. Eta marker | C. Theta marker | D. Iota
       marker
●​ Correct Answer: Option A (Zeta marker)
●​ Why Correct: Zeta is the fixture marker for condition Q.
●​ Why Other Options Are Wrong: Options B, C, and D are markers of other fixture conditions.

MCQ 2: Made-up Drug Question With Bulleted Options
●​ Question Stem: Which fixture drug treats condition R?
●​ Options:
      ○​ A. Drugamab
      ○​ B. Fixturinib
      ○​ C. Sampleparin (e.g., C. sample strains resist it)
      ○​ D. Mockazole
●​ Correct Answer: Option B (Fixturinib)
●​ Why Correct: Fixturinib is the fixture drug of choice.
●​ Why Other Options Are Wrong: Option A treats condition S; Options C and D are unrelated.

○​   MCQ 88 (Beta 2098 – MCQ 88): Made-up Table Question
Question Stem: Which statement about fixture habit H is true?
●​

      Option      Statement

        A         It lowers fixture risk X by about
                  half
         B        It raises fixture risk X tenfold
     Option       Statement
        C         It has no effect on anything
        D         It cures condition Q
Correct Answer: Option A (It lowers fixture risk X)
Why Correct: Habit H halves fixture risk X.

MCQ 3: Made-up Repeat
●​ Question Stem: Which fixture marker is raised in condition Q?
●​ Options: A. Zeta marker | B. Eta marker | C. Theta marker | D. Iota marker
●​ Correct Answer: Option A (Zeta marker)

MCQ 4: Made-up Spill Host
●​ Question Stem: Which fixture organ makes enzyme E?
●​ Options: A. Fixture liver | B. Fixture spleen | C. Fixture bone | D. Fixture skin
●​ Correct Answer: Option A (Fixture liver)
●​ Why Correct: The fixture liver makes enzyme E.
●​ Question Stem: Which fixture vitamin prevents sign V?
●​ Options: A. Vitamin Fx | B. Vitamin Gx | C. Vitamin Hx | D. Vitamin Jx
●​ Correct Answer: Option D (Vitamin Jx)
●​ Why Correct: Vitamin Jx prevents sign V.

MCQ 5: Made-up Rapid Fire Heading Without A Stem
●​ Topic Discussion: Several fixture pearls.
